bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
BRANCH="fix/operation-help-current-menu-20261114"
SHA="535910f6658cc54a5cbca09250e19d97d3a5554a"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/gaybbs-menu-20261115"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$SHA"
test -d "$WT"
test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
git -C "$WT" checkout --detach "$SHA"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"
LIVE="deploy-gaybbs-1"
test "$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
COMPOSE="$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}')"
test -f "$COMPOSE"
test "${COMPOSE##*/}" = gserver-compose.yaml
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy config -q
printf 'SOURCE_SHA=%s\nCOMPOSE_PREFLIGHT=PASS\n' "$SHA"
LOG="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
if docker build --network=host --progress=plain -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115-final "$WT" >"$LOG" 2>&1; then
 docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115-final >/dev/null
 echo BUILD=PASS
else
 if grep -Eq 'ERR_PNPM|frozen-lockfile' "$LOG"; then exit 51; fi
 if grep -Eq 'no space left|ENOSPC' "$LOG"; then exit 52; fi
 if grep -Eq 'network is unreachable|ETIMEDOUT|ECONNREFUSED|TLS handshake' "$LOG"; then exit 53; fi
 exit 55
fi
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-menu-20261115-final
good=0
recover(){
 if [ "$good" -ne 1 ]; then
  docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-menu-20261115-final gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || true
  docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || true
 fi
}
trap recover EXIT
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115-final gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
 if [ "$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true ] &&
  docker exec "$LIVE" sh -c 'test -s /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "クリエーター投稿" /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "🔗ボタン生成" /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "dm:chat-select" /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "dm:invite-select" /app/gaybbs.mjs'; then
  good=1
  break
 fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$good" = 1
trap - EXIT
printf 'GAYBBS_MENU_DEPLOY=PASS\nBUNDLE_3_BUTTONS=PASS\nCONTAINER_RUNNING=YES\n'
